clarifications.tfidf_fit_corpus: The character n-gram document frequencies and vocabulary are computed from the 1443 state-bank user prompts only. Target prompts are transformed against that fixed state-bank vocabulary and never affect IDF.
clarifications.tfidf_feature_identity: A feature is the exact Unicode character n-gram string paired with its n in {2,3,4}; no hashing or vocabulary truncation is used.
clarifications.empty_vector_behavior: If a target has no state-bank vocabulary features, every cosine score is zero and the lowest state-bank source index wins the declared tie break.
clarifications.write_token_count_scope: Token count is computed from the complete system-plus-user write prompt after the frozen Gemma chat template with add_generation_prompt=false.
clarifications.selection_baseline_partition: Correct-state, zero-state, and frozen-base baselines are scored on exactly the same hash-defined fit or holdout target indices as the retrieval output.
clarifications.phase_one_execution: A shard may compute the deterministic mapping for every target to bind it, but it may only generate and append retrieval outputs for fit targets.
clarifications.phase_two_execution: The holdout runner must validate a signed selection receipt and reject every method other than the selected method before model loading.
